meta: Building apps with AI is handy, until you paste a real password into the code. Keep secrets out of code, get customer data checked by an expert, and build tools for yourself.

muc.title: A password in the code
muc.text: Your homemade app is really handy, until you paste a real password into the code.

muc.title: Don't expose secret keys
muc.text: If a password, API key or bank code sits in the code, anyone who can see the app can take it. Keep them somewhere private.

muc.title: Customer data needs an expert
muc.text: If the app stores customers' phone numbers or takes payments, have someone who knows security review it before letting others use it.

muc.title: Best for your own tasks
muc.text: Vibe coding works best for tools just for you, like a timesheet, a cost calculator, or a learning game for your kids.

muc.title: Three tools just for you
muc.text: List three things you do over and over every week, pick the simplest, and ask AI to turn it into a small tool.
